books.t: The Hymnal of the Christian Methodist Episcopal Church
books.d: The official hymnal of the Christian Methodist Episcopal Church, a historically Black Methodist denomination founded in Jackson, Tennessee in 1870. Hymns, responsive readings, and the order of worship.
John O'Leary, who survived severe burns as a child and became a speaker, argues adults can recover five childlike traits (wonder, expectancy, immersion, belonging, freedom) to live more fully.
Phaidon and the Met's keyword-organized survey of about 800 works from the museum's collection, arranged by concept rather than by period, in a slipcase.

books.t: Probability and Statistics for Engineers and Scientists, 4th ed.
books.d: Long-running introductory probability and statistics text for engineering students. Distributions, estimation, hypothesis tests, regression, quality control. The 4th edition is the last Walpole and Myers edition before Myers and Ye joined.
Noah S. Brannen's compact romanized dictionary (Weatherhill) aimed at beginners who do not yet read kana, with usage notes on everyday Japanese.
Tuttle's blank genkō yōshi grid workbook for practicing kana and kanji stroke order and composition.
Scott McCloud's theory of comics written as a comic. Covers the icon, closure between panels, time and motion, and why simplified faces invite identification. A standard text in visual studies.

books.a: 阪田史郎・嶋本薫 編著
books.d: Comprehensive Japanese reference on wireless communication technology (radio propagation, modulation, cellular, WLAN, sensor networks) edited by Sakata Shirō and Shimamoto Kaoru, published by RIC Telecom.

books.t: Avatar: The Last Airbender, Smoke and Shadow
books.d: Gene Luen Yang and Gurihiru's third Avatar comic trilogy. Zuko faces the Kemurikage kidnappings and his mother's return, set in the Fire Nation after The Search.
Thomas Mann's The Magic Mountain in the original German. Hans Castorp visits a Davos sanatorium for three weeks and stays seven years amid debates on time, illness, and European culture before 1914.
Justice Amy Coney Barrett's book on how she reads the Constitution and statutes, originalism, precedent, and the working life of the Supreme Court.
Council on Foreign Relations journal issue, March/April 2025, volume 104 number 2. Essays on current international affairs.

books.t: The Ecological Approach to Visual Perception
books.d: James J. Gibson's final statement of ecological psychology. Perception is direct pickup of information from the ambient optic array, and the environment offers affordances. Foundational for embodied cognition and HCI.
Illustrated or abridged Golden Press edition of Twain's boyhood novel of Tom, Huck, Becky, and Injun Joe in St. Petersburg, Missouri.

books.t: Foreign Relations of the United States 1964-1968, Vol. XV, Germany and Berlin
books.d: Foreign Relations of the United States, the State Department's official documentary record. Volume XV covers Germany and Berlin in the Johnson years, including NATO nuclear sharing and the Berlin question.

books.t: Monument Wars: Washington, D.C., the National Mall, and the Transformation of the Memorial Landscape
books.d: Kirk Savage traces how the National Mall grew from a grove into a memorial landscape, from the Washington Monument to the Vietnam wall, and how memorials shifted from heroic statues to spaces of experience.
Hueber practice grammar for intermediate German learners (B1 to B2), by Hering, Matussek, and Perlmann-Balme. Exercises with keys, useful alongside a course.
Survey of highlights from museums across Southeast Asia (Thailand, Cambodia, Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines and others), published by ArtPostAsia. Title partly hidden in the photo.
David Wootton's edition of The Prince with selections from the Discourses on Livy and letters, with an introduction on Machiavelli's republicanism.

books.t: 漢文早覚え速答法 パーフェクト版
books.d: Tanaka Yūji's famous Gakken exam-prep book teaching kanbun (classical Chinese read Japanese-style) through a small set of high-frequency patterns and 'speed answer' rules. A staple for university entrance exams.

books.t: The Thousand and One Lives of the Buddha
books.d: Bernard Faure argues there is no single life of the Buddha to recover. He surveys how the biography was retold across India, Tibet, China, Japan and modern scholarship, and what each retelling wanted.
Locke's empiricist account of knowledge. No innate ideas, all ideas from sensation and reflection, personal identity as continuity of consciousness, and the limits of what we can know.

Kierkegaard, writing as Johannes de Silentio, meditates on Abraham's willingness to sacrifice Isaac. Faith as a leap beyond the ethical, the knight of faith, and the teleological suspension of the ethical.

Hobbes's account of the state of nature as war of all against all and the social contract that creates an absolute sovereign. Also a materialist theory of mind and a long critique of religious authority.

books.t: The Book of Mormon: Another Testament of Jesus Christ
books.d: The scripture of the Latter-day Saint movement, presented by Joseph Smith as a translation of ancient American records. Standard LDS edition.

books.t: BLと中国 耽美をめぐる社会情勢と魅力
books.d: Zhou Mi's study of boys' love (danmei) culture in China, its fan communities, the social climate around it, and its appeal, written for a Japanese readership.

books.t: 引退した皇帝騎士、かつて救った少女たちに…
books.d: Fantasia Bunko light novel. The visible part of the title reads 'the retired imperial knight and the girls he once saved'. Rest is hidden, so the series could not be confirmed.

books.t: Satyajit Ray Miscellany: On Life, Cinema, People & Much More
books.d: Collected essays, interviews, sketches and reflections by the Bengali filmmaker Satyajit Ray on cinema, music, childhood, and the people he worked with.
C. H. Edwards Jr.'s rigorous multivariable calculus built on linear algebra. Differential forms, manifolds, implicit function theorem. A common bridge between calculus and analysis.

books.a: Oscar Wilde, illus. Maisie Paradise Shearring
books.d: Oscar Wilde's tale of the gilded statue who asks a swallow to give away his jewels to the poor, in a picture-book edition illustrated by Maisie Paradise Shearring.
Greg McKeown's case for doing fewer things deliberately. Explore, eliminate, execute. A popular productivity book.
The Harvard Negotiation Project's method of principled negotiation. Separate people from the problem, focus on interests not positions, invent options, insist on objective criteria.
Machiavelli's manual for a new prince on acquiring and keeping power, with its notorious advice on cruelty, fear versus love, and fortune versus virtù. Penguin Classics edition.

books.t: 太陽と鉄・私の遍歴時代
books.d: Sun and Steel, Mishima's confession of his turn from words to the body and bodybuilding, paired with My Wandering Years, his memoir of his early literary life.
Ann McClellan's National Geographic book on the Washington D.C. cherry trees, their 1912 gift from Tokyo, and the cultural history of sakura in Japan.
John A. Daly (UT Austin) on how to get ideas adopted inside organizations. Framing, timing, alliances, and credibility. Yale University Press.

books.t: The Ultimate Guide to the 2020 Election
books.d: Diversion Books voter guide covering candidates, the electoral process and the issues of the 2020 US election.
Posthumous memoir of Congressman Elijah Cummings, written with James Dale, on his Baltimore upbringing, his career in the House, and his last fights over oversight of the Trump administration.
Annette Gordon-Reed's essays on Texas, slavery, her own family, and why Juneteenth matters. Hardcover, first of two copies.
Tyndale's New Living Translation New Testament with notes for new Christians (Greg Laurie's New Believer's series).
Second hardcover copy of On Juneteenth.
L. M. Montgomery's novel of the red-haired orphan Anne Shirley sent by mistake to the Cuthberts at Green Gables on Prince Edward Island.
Anthony Aveni, an astronomer and anthropologist, on how cultures have measured time. Calendars of the Maya, Inca, Chinese and West, and the astronomy behind them.

books.t: The Tangled Web: Military Deception in Large-Scale Combat Operations
books.d: Army University Press essay collection (edited by Christopher M. Rein) on military deception in large-scale combat, with historical cases from WWII to the present.
Robert Alter reads the Hebrew Bible as literature, arguing its narrative and poetic artistry is inseparable from its religious meaning. Companion to The Art of Biblical Narrative.

books.t: The Debate on the Constitution, Part One
books.d: Library of America collection, edited by Bernard Bailyn, of Federalist and Antifederalist speeches, articles, and letters from September 1787 to February 1788 on ratifying the Constitution.

books.t: Extraordinary Popular Delusions and the Madness of Crowds
books.d: Charles Mackay's classic on mass mania. Tulipomania, the South Sea Bubble, the Mississippi Scheme, alchemists, the Crusades, witch trials, and haunted houses.
One volume of the illustrated partwork series The Great Artists. Volume title hidden, possibly Gauguin.
Tracy Chevalier's novel imagining Griet, a maid in Vermeer's Delft household, as the model for the painting. Plume paperback.
A monograph on Paul Gauguin. Publisher and series not visible on the spine.
Flame Tree's illustrated survey of Van Gogh's major paintings with commentary by Rosalind Ormiston.
Illustrated anthology of classic European fairy tales (Grimm, Perrault, Andersen) compiled by Caroline Bugler.
Rosemary Ellen Guiley's A to Z reference on demons, exorcism, possession, and demonology across religions and folklore. Checkmark Books.
Raymond Buckland, a founder of American Wicca, on spirit communication. Seances, mediumship, automatic writing, spirit boards, and the history of Spiritualism.
Melville's novel of Ishmael, Ahab, and the white whale, in a leather-bound collector's edition with gilt wave ornament.
Tuttle reader of Vietnamese folktales presented bilingually with vocabulary and cultural notes, by Tri C. Tran and Tram Le, with audio.

books.t: The Rising Sun: The Decline and Fall of the Japanese Empire 1936-1945
books.d: John Toland's Pulitzer Prize history of Japan from 1936 to 1945 told from the Japanese side, based on interviews with surviving officers and officials.
Collins pocket phrase book for travelers in Italy.

books.t: Saint Saul: A Skeleton Key to the Historical Jesus
books.d: Donald Harman Akenson argues Paul's letters, the earliest Christian writings, are the best key to the historical Jesus, and criticizes the Jesus Seminar's methods.
Jenna Weissman Joselit on how American Jews between 1880 and 1950 invented a domestic Jewish culture through food, holidays, weddings, and consumer goods. Hill and Wang.
Thomas P. Hughes's history of a century of American invention and technological enthusiasm, 1870 to 1970, from Edison and Tesla to Ford, the TVA, and the Manhattan Project. Pulitzer finalist.
Eviatar Zerubavel's history and sociology of the seven-day week, from Babylon and the Sabbath to French and Soviet attempts to abolish it.
Frederick Turner's 10,000-line science fiction epic in verse about the terraforming of Mars and a rebellion of colonists against Earth's ecotheist regime.
Patterson and Hennessy's introductory computer architecture textbook. Instruction sets, pipelining, memory hierarchy, I/O. Edition (MIPS, ARM, or RISC-V) not visible.

books.t: Film and Politics in the Weimar Republic
books.d: Essays on Weimar cinema and its politics (edited by Thomas G. Plummer and others, Holmes and Meier), from Caligari to Kuhle Wampe.
Brimax illustrated hardcover collection of traditional English nursery rhymes.
Joseph Heller's satire of Yossarian and the bombardiers of Pianosa, and the bureaucratic logic that makes escape impossible.
CLAMP's story of Hideki, a cram-school student who finds a discarded persocom, Chi, and the question of whether she can love. Dark Horse omnibus Book 1 collects volumes 1 to 4.

books.t: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ 2年生編 1
books.d: Kinugasa Shōgo's Classroom of the Elite, Year 2 volume 1. Ayanokōji's second year at the Advanced Nurturing High School begins with a new special exam. MF Bunko J.
Sterling collection of reported true ghost stories from across the United States, from the Weird N.J. team, edited by Joanne Austin.
Anthony Burgess's dystopia narrated in Nadsat by Alex, a violent teenager subjected to aversion therapy. Norton edition.
Gilt-lettered navy hardcover surveying unexplained historical episodes. Publisher and author not visible.
Kris Brandt Riske's Llewellyn guide to natal astrology. Signs, houses, planets, aspects, chart interpretation, for beginners through intermediate readers.
David Klinghoffer's account of Abraham and the origins of monotheism, drawing on Jewish tradition and modern scholarship. Doubleday.
Three essays by Azizah al-Hibri, Jean Bethke Elshtain, and Charles Haynes on religion in the American public square, with responses. Norton, from the Pew Forum's series.
George Martin's guide to opera. Histories, plot synopses and musical notes for about 47 standard operas, plus essays on opera houses and singers. Amadeus Press.

books.t: Stories of the Great Operas & Their Composers
books.d: Ernest Newman's synopses and commentary on 30 standard operas, arranged by composer. Dorset reprint.

books.t: Milestone Express 2024 (早大生のための総合情報誌 No. 43)
books.a: マイルストーン編集会
books.d: Milestone Express, the Waseda University student-run campus guide (No. 43). Course reviews, club listings, and survival tips for new Waseda students.
A blue hardcover selection of Dickinson's poems. Edition not visible.
Dewey's Tokyo lectures on pragmatism. Philosophy should be reconstructed to solve social problems rather than pursue fixed certainties. Beacon paperback.

books.t: Western Political Theory: From Its Origins to the Present
books.d: Lee Cameron McDonald's college survey of Western political thought from the Greeks to the 20th century. Harcourt, Brace and World.

books.t: Who Married Figaro? A Book of Opera Characters
books.d: Joyce Bourne's Oxford A to Z of opera characters, with who they are, who sings them, and where they appear.
Gregory J. Riley argues the many early images of Christ grew from the Greco-Roman hero tradition, and that diversity, not a single creed, marked the first Christians.

books.t: Britain and Europe in the Seventeenth Century
books.d: J. R. Jones's history of English foreign policy and its ties to Europe from James I to Anne, and how it shaped domestic politics.

The last will and testament of Robert Keayne, a Boston merchant censured by the Puritan church for overcharging, in which he defends his conduct. A key source on Puritan economic ethics. Harper Torchbooks.

books.t: The Rising Sun: The Decline and Fall of the Japanese Empire 1936-1945
books.d: Second copy or the same copy of Toland's The Rising Sun (see B-B1-22).
Frederick Denny's short introduction to Islam and the Muslim community, in the Harper and Row Religious Traditions of the World series.
The first Wheel of Time novel. Rand, Mat, Perrin and Egwene flee the Two Rivers with the Aes Sedai Moiraine as the Dark One stirs. Tor paperback.
Peter Paret's intellectual biography of Clausewitz, setting On War in the context of the Prussian reform era and Clausewitz's own campaigns.

books.t: Free Culture: The Nature and Future of Creativity
books.d: Lawrence Lessig on how expanding copyright and digital lockdown threaten the culture of remixing and borrowing that creativity depends on. Released under a Creative Commons license.
James Bowman's history of honor from Homer to the present, arguing the West abandoned it after WWI and now misreads honor cultures it confronts. Encounter Books.
Fawn Brodie's psychobiography of Jefferson, notable for taking seriously his relationship with Sally Hemings decades before DNA evidence. Norton.
A collected edition of Seneca's Stoic writings, likely Letters from a Stoic with essays such as On the Shortness of Life and On Anger. Publisher not visible.
Essays edited by Morton Smith and R. Joseph Hoffmann in which scholars lay out what the Bible actually says on topics from creation and sexuality to the afterlife.

books.t: The Jesus of Heresy and History
books.d: John Dart on the Nag Hammadi library and Gnostic Christianity, revised from his earlier The Laughing Savior.
Pablo Neruda's love poems, mostly from The Captain's Verses, in Donald Walsh's translation, a slim bilingual volume.
A. J. P. Taylor's polemical short history arguing German history repeatedly failed to produce liberal government, written at the end of the war.
Erich Fromm on dreams, fairy tales and myths as a universal symbolic language, with readings of Oedipus, Little Red Riding Hood, and Kafka.
The Life Book, a free Gospel of John with student commentary distributed to high schools by the Life Book Movement.
Jane Austen's novel of Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy. Dover Thrift edition.

books.a: Nokiya, original story Bones / Tensai Okamura
books.d: Nokiya's manga adaptation of the Bones anime about Hei, a Contractor working for the Syndicate around Hell's Gate in a near-future Tokyo. Yen Press.

books.t: Great Books of the Western World, Vol. 19: Thomas Aquinas I
books.d: Volume 19 of Britannica's Great Books of the Western World, the first of two Aquinas volumes, containing the opening parts of the Summa Theologica in the Dominican Fathers' translation.

books.t: 百合姫 20周年記念アンソロジー (yh comics; spine letters Y R H M, tagline 20年目の女と女の関係性)
books.d: Anthology marking the 20th anniversary of Comic Yuri Hime, Ichijinsha's yuri magazine, with short works by its regular artists. The spine tagline reads 'twenty years of relationships between women'.

books.t: Introduction to the Theory of Computation, 3rd ed.
books.d: Michael Sipser's standard text on automata, computability and complexity. Regular and context-free languages, Turing machines, decidability, P and NP.

books.t: 頼むから静かにしてくれ I
books.a: レイモンド・カーヴァー, 村上春樹 訳
books.d: Volume 1 of Murakami Haruki's translation of Raymond Carver's first collection, Will You Please Be Quiet, Please? From the Murakami Haruki Translation Library, Chūō Kōron Shinsha.

books.t: 数々の告白を振ってきた学校のマドンナに外堀を埋められました
books.pub: ダッシュエックス文庫
books.d: Light novel by Nekokuro. A boy is gradually cornered by the school's untouchable madonna who has turned down every other confession. Romantic comedy.

books.t: 魔王討伐のごほうびは…
books.d: MF Bunko J light novel whose title begins 'as a reward for defeating the Demon King...'. Rest hidden.
Natsume Sōseki's Kusamakura (The Three-Cornered World). A painter retreats to a mountain hot-spring village seeking a 'non-human' detachment and meets the enigmatic Nami. Shinchō Bunko.

Somerset Maugham's The Moon and Sixpence. Charles Strickland, a London stockbroker modeled on Gauguin, abandons his family to paint in Paris and Tahiti. This copy still has the Shinchō Bunko 100 obi and stained-glass bookmark.

books.t: '... Official Visual Archive' (anime art book, black-haired girl in uniform, cherry blossoms)
books.d: Official visual archive art book for an anime or game series. The series name is hidden by glare. Cover shows a black-haired girl in uniform with cherry blossoms.

books.t: Masterpieces of Okumura Togyū from the Yamatane Collection
books.d: Yamatane Museum catalogue of Okumura Togyū (1889 to 1990), nihonga painter of soft, luminous landscapes. The cover is his Naruto whirlpool painting.
Jordan B. Peterson's readings of Genesis, Exodus, Jonah and other biblical narratives as psychological and moral maps. Portfolio.
Tuttle's All-Romanized English-Japanese Dictionary by the Hyōjun Rōmaji Kai. Gives Japanese equivalents in romanization only, for travelers and beginners.
James Elkins on the nature of seeing. Vision is never neutral; objects look back, and looking is entangled with desire, blindness, and the body. Harcourt.

books.t: 義妹なら本気になってもいいよね？ 1
books.d: HJ Bunko romantic comedy light novel, volume 1, about a stepsister relationship. Author name not legible.

books.t: やはり俺の青春ラブコメはまちがっている。 結 2
books.d: Volume 2 of the Oregairu 'Ketsu' (結) side series by Watari Wataru, continuing the story after the main series. Gagaga Bunko.

books.t: シナモロールの『エチカ』 感情に支配されないヒント
books.d: Sanrio's Cinnamoroll presents ideas from Spinoza's Ethics as gentle advice on not being ruled by emotions. A pop-philosophy self-help book.

books.t: light novel by 猫又ぬこ, title ends '...過ぎる件'
books.d: Kodansha Ranobe Bunko light novel by Nekomata Nuko. Only the end of the title, '...is too much', is readable.
Giorgio Vasari's biographies of Italian Renaissance artists from Cimabue to Michelangelo, the founding text of art history. Oxford World's Classics selection translated by the Bondanellas.

books.t: 漢文道場 基礎編 句形理解と演習
books.d: Z-kai's kanbun workbook, foundation volume. Sentence-pattern (句形) explanations with graded exercises, pitched from basics to the Common Test.

books.t: 高校古文漢文をひとつひとつわかりやすく。
books.d: Gakken's step-by-step primer on high-school classical Japanese and kanbun, one concept per spread, from the 'hitotsu hitotsu wakariyasuku' series.

books.t: これは水です (This Is Water)
books.a: デヴィッド・フォスター・ウォレス
books.d: David Foster Wallace's Kenyon College commencement address, This Is Water, on attention, default settings, and choosing what to worship. Japanese translation.

books.t: 私を喰べたい、ひとでなし 1
books.d: Naekawa Sai's yuri horror manga. Hinako, a girl who wants to die, meets Shiori, a mermaid-like monster who wants to eat her. Dengeki Comics NEXT, volume 1.

books.t: ネットの『推し』とリアルの『推し』が隣に引っ越してきた 4
books.d: Manga (art by Katakei) about a boy whose online idol and real-life crush turn out to be the same girl who moves in next door. Comic Gardo, volume 4.

books.t: 伊藤潤二傑作集 9 墓標の町
books.d: Junji Ito Masterpiece Collection volume 9, 墓標の町 (Town of No Return, also known as Gravestone Town), horror short stories including the title story about a town where corpses become gravestones.
Tsutsui Yasutaka's experimental novel in which the sounds of the Japanese syllabary vanish one by one, and the text itself loses those sounds as it goes. Went viral again in 2021. Chūkō Bunko.
Mishima's Kyoko's House. Four young men (a boxer, an actor, a painter, a businessman) orbit Kyoko's salon in postwar Tokyo. Shinchō Bunko.
Wittgenstein's numbered propositions on logic, language, and the limits of what can be said. Dover edition of the Ogden translation.

books.t: 大学学部コレクト 改訂版 (学コレ)
books.d: A guide for high-school students that introduces sixteen university faculties as anime-style characters, explaining what each field studies and where it leads.

books.t: きみが死ぬまで恋をしたい 1
books.pub: 百合姫コミックス / 一迅社
books.d: Aono Nachi's yuri manga My Wish Is to Fall in Love Until You Die. Mimi enters a military academy for girls and meets the fated Sheena. Ichijinsha Yuri Hime Comics, volume 1.
Maxwell Rosenlicht's concise real analysis. Metric spaces, continuity, differentiation, Riemann integration, sequences of functions. A compact alternative to Rudin.
Japanese translation of Mallarmé's poems by Katō Yoshio, published by Shōshinsha, a small press known for poetry.

books.t: 山種美術館所蔵 速水御舟作品集
books.d: Yamatane Museum catalogue of Hayami Gyoshū (1894 to 1935), the nihonga painter of Dance of Flames. The museum holds the largest collection of his work.

books.t: 桜 SAKURA 名品画集: Masterpieces Depicting Cherry Trees and Blossoms from the Yamatane Collection
books.d: Yamatane Museum catalogue of cherry-blossom paintings from its collection, bilingual, with works by Okumura Togyū, Hayami Gyoshū and others.
Official catalogue for Comic Market 106 (August 2025), with circle listings, maps, and rules for the event.

books.t: 山種美術館 開館50周年記念 近代日本画名品選100 (100 Masterpieces of Modern Japanese Paintings Selected from the Yamatane Collection)
books.d: Catalogue for the Yamatane Museum's 50th anniversary, selecting 100 masterpieces of modern nihonga from its collection (Hayami, Okumura, Higashiyama Kaii, Kobayashi Kokei and others). Bilingual.

books.t: Milky mellow: なのはなこひな イラスト総集編 (Kohina Nanohana Original Illustration Book)
books.d: Doujin illustration collection by the artist Nanohana Kohina, gathering pastel character art from the circles milkymellow and cottontail.

books.t: 白隠 禅画の教え 日めくり
books.d: A perpetual daily flip calendar of Zen paintings by Hakuin Ekaku (1686 to 1769), the reviver of Rinzai Zen, with commentary by Yoshizawa Katsuhiro. Tokyo Bijutsu.

books.t: 記号と再帰 新装版 記号論の形式・プログラムの必然
books.d: Tanaka-Ishii Kumiko's semiotics of programming. Programming languages examined through Peirce's and Saussure's sign theories, with recursion and reflexivity as the central themes. Won the Suntory Prize. English version, Semiotics of Programming, Cambridge 2010.
Japanese edition of the Hermès Foundation's Savoir & Faire volume on earth as a material, from soil science to ceramics and architecture.

books.t: 東京国立博物館 日本美術五十選
books.d: Tokyo National Museum's picture book of fifty selected Japanese artworks from its collection.

books.t: The Messiah Myth: The Near Eastern Roots of Jesus and David
books.d: Thomas L. Thompson argues the gospel Jesus is built from ancient Near Eastern royal and messianic motifs rather than biography.

books.t: Framed for Posterity: The Enduring Philosophy of the Constitution
books.d: Ralph Ketcham on the political philosophy the framers assumed and how later generations reinterpreted it.

books.t: All Things Shining: Reading the Western Classics to Find Meaning in a Secular Age
books.d: Dreyfus and Kelly read Homer, Dante, Melville and others to recover a sense of the sacred in a secular age.

books.t: Revelation: The Torah and the Bible
books.d: Jacob Neusner on how Judaism and Christianity each understand scripture as revelation.
Ward Lock reference outline of English history, a school handbook.

books.t: Opera 101: A Complete Guide to Learning and Loving Opera
books.d: Fred Plotkin's beginner's guide to opera with listening guides to eleven operas.
William James's Gifford Lectures on conversion, mysticism and saintliness studied as psychology.
Simon Ings's popular science of the eye and vision, from optics to the brain.
Six Murakami stories set in the weeks after the 1995 Kobe earthquake.

books.t: 寿命を買い取ってもらった。一年につき、一万円で。 3
books.a: 三秋縋 原作 / 田口囁一 漫画
books.pub: 集英社 ジャンプコミックス+
books.d: Manga adaptation of Sugaru Miaki's novel about a man who sells his remaining lifespan for ten thousand yen a year. Volume 3.

books.t: 寿命を買い取ってもらった。一年につき、一万円で。 2
books.a: 三秋縋 原作 / 田口囁一 漫画
books.pub: 集英社 ジャンプコミックス+
books.d: Volume 2 of the same manga.
Kant's central work on the limits of reason and the conditions of experience. Penguin Classics edition.
Matsuri Hino's shojo manga about Yuki Cross and the vampire Night Class at Cross Academy. Volume 1.
J. B. Priestley's illustrated survey of ideas about time, from physics to precognition.

books.t: Paul the Convert: The Apostolate and Apostasy of Saul the Pharisee
books.d: Alan Segal reads Paul as a Jewish convert to a form of apocalyptic Judaism and examines his mysticism.

books.t: Peoples of an Almighty God: Competing Religions in the Ancient World
books.d: Jonathan Goldstein's history of competing religions in the ancient Mediterranean and Near East.
DK illustrated reference to the meanings of symbols across cultures.
Hemingway's Spanish Civil War novel of Robert Jordan and the bridge.

books.t: The General History of Socialism and Social Struggles, Vol. 2
books.d: Max Beer's two-volume Marxist history of socialist movements from antiquity to the 20th century. Volume 2.
Teach Yourself short Italian grammar reference.

books.t: A Brief History of the Mind
books.d: William Calvin's short account of the evolution of the human mind and language.
Ayn Rand's novel of the architect Howard Roark. Signet paperback.
Beckett's one-act play of Hamm and Clov in a bare room at the end of the world.
Bataille's short transgressive novella. City Lights edition.
Eco's medieval murder mystery set in an abbey library. Harcourt paperback.
REA's compressed AP World History review.

books.t: algebra textbook, pale spine reading ALGEBRA with 'Intro' above it
Gregg Typing for Colleges, Complete Course
books.d: Gregg's college typing course textbook.

books.t: Paragraph Power: Communicating Ideas Through Paragraphs
books.d: ESL composition textbook on paragraph writing.
Ferriss's collection of short interviews with over a hundred high performers.
Neil Strauss's follow-up to The Game, a 30-day guide plus stories.
Horkheimer's Frankfurt School essays including Traditional and Critical Theory.
Prabhupāda's translation and commentary on the Gītā, the standard ISKCON edition.
Sterne's digressive comic novel. Norton Critical Edition with essays.
First eight chapters of the Bhāgavata Purāṇa with Prabhupāda's commentary.
Brontë's novel. Barnes & Noble Classics edition.
Tolstoy's novel in the Penguin clothbound edition.
Ocean Vuong's novel written as a letter from Little Dog to his Vietnamese mother.
